segments.text:
V. 44.
Whence I came out—He ſpeaks as if he had come out of his own Accord: See his Pride! He findeth it empty—Of GOD, of Chriſt, of his Spirit: Swept—From Love, Lowlineſs, Meekneſs, and all the Fruits of the Spirit: And garniſhed—With Levity and Security: So that there is nothing to keep him out, and much to invite him in.
